text:
deploy-bot: RC created: rc-2026-03-21-17.1.2
artifact: registry.redwood/infra/rc-17.1.2@sha256:a1b2c3d4
change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00 UTC
release notes: https://wiki.redwood/relnotes/17.1.2
canary plan: 5% -> 25% (15m) -> 100% (auto)
required signoffs: @erin, @bob, @carol
rollback: route traffic back to v17.1.1 + feature-flag rollback for `new-scheduler`
runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rc-17.1.2-runbook

erin (Release Manager): tagging for visibility, I can shepherd the promo if approvals are in. ops-oncall is confirmed for the window.

bob (SRE): quick checklist from me before go:
- pin model-serving nodepools to gpu-pool-4 for this promo
- pre-warm KV cache across us-east1/us-west1
- increase autoscaler target for pods that handle batching by 20% for first 30m
- smoke widgets/latency alert set at 2x baseline
Commands I'll run post-promo if rollback needed:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=17.1.1
/infra/scripts/ff-toggle --off new-scheduler --env=prod
```
I'll watch for OOMs and sustained 95p latency.

carol (QA): ran the reg-suite in staging (full) against rc-17.1.2. Smoke passed for most flows but found a flaky edge in multi-turn agent: occasionally truncated tokens on >1024 inputs. Filing a bug: https://issues.redwood/INC-8421
I recommend we: add a quick smoke that exercises long-context paths during canary and keep the feature flag off until we verify.

alice (Eng): artifact pinned in the release repo, migration task queued: `2026-03-22T01:30 UTC` will kick off DB schema add (safe, no blocking migration). KV pre-warm script scheduled: `/infra/kv/warm --regions=us-east1,us-west1`
I also added a short-circuit in model-serving so we can toggle to a lighter quantized variant if memory spikes.

dave (Product): from product side we prefer hold on the `new-scheduler` heavy path; if QA wants the flag off for initial canary that's fine. Keep us posted on any UX regressions.

erin (Release Manager): ack from me once SRE starts pre-warm and QA verifies the long-context smoke. Also: support rota for the window is @ops-oncall then ops-oncall -> @bob after first hour.

ops-oncall: oncall coverage confirmed 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll open a short-lived incident channel during rollout.

bob (SRE): starting pre-warm now and pinning nodepools. Pasting the warm command output summary: `kv warm started: 4 shards, target qps 120, estimated time 6m`

deploy-bot: Promo scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:05:00Z (canary start) -> deploy steps queued. Will post when canary is live.

carol (QA): long-context smoke (1k+ tokens) added to canary checklist. I'll run a verification at canary+10m and report.

alice (Eng): confirming migration will run at 01:30 UTC; it has a no-downtime toggle. If any step fails we abort promo and run rollback commands.

dave (Product): thanks. marking product ack for conditional promo (feature flag off).

erin (Release Manager): final signoffs: @bob (SRE) ✅, @carol (QA) ✅, @alice (Eng) ✅, @dave (Product) ✅. Proceed when deploy-bot schedules.

deploy-bot: Promo queued and will execute per the canary plan. Notifying release_watchers and opening ephemeral channel #rc-17-1-2-promo for live updates.

ops-oncall: I'll create the ephemeral channel at promo start and drop runbook link there.

bob (SRE): monitoring hooks added: latency, error-rate, OOMs. If any of these trigger the abort clause (error-rate > 1% sustained 3m or OOM spike), I'll execute the rollback snippet above.

carol (QA): I'll post the canary+10m verification in the ephemeral channel.

erin (Release Manager): good work team. leaving final go/no-go to the deploy window. If anything changes, ping here. :thumbsup:
